sentences.zh: 韋夏卿，字雲客，杜陵人。

translations.literal: Wei Xiaqing, styled Yunke, was a native of Duling.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Xiaqing, styled Yunke, was a native of Duling.

sentences.zh: 父迢，檢校都官郎中、嶺南節度行軍司馬。

translations.literal: His father Tiao served as Acting Director of the Bureau of Justice and Military Affairs Aide of the Lingnan Military Commission.
translations.idiomatic: His father Tiao served as Acting Director of the Bureau of Justice and Military Affairs Aide of the Lingnan Military Commission.

sentences.zh: 夏卿苦學，大暦中與弟正卿倶應制舉，同時策入髙等，授髙陵主簿。

translations.literal: Xiaqing studied arduously. In the Dali era he and his younger brother Zhengqing both took the imperial examination; they passed the policy examination with high rank at the same time and were appointed chief clerk of Gaoling County.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaqing studied hard. In the Dali era he and his younger brother Zhengqing both took the imperial examination together, passed the policy examination with high rank, and were appointed chief clerks of Gaoling County.

sentences.zh: 累遷刑部員外郎。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Vice Director in the Ministry of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: He was repeatedly promoted to Vice Director in the Ministry of Justice.

sentences.zh: 時久旱蝗，詔於郎官中選赤畿令，改奉天縣令。

translations.literal: When there was prolonged drought and locust plague, an edict selected from among palace officials those to serve as magistrates of the metropolitan suburban counties; he was reassigned as magistrate of Fengtian County.
translations.idiomatic: During a prolonged drought and locust plague, an edict ordered that palace officials be chosen as magistrates of the metropolitan suburban counties; he was reassigned as magistrate of Fengtian County.

sentences.zh: 以課最第一，轉長安令。

translations.literal: Because his administration rating ranked first, he was transferred to serve as magistrate of Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: Because his administration rating ranked first, he was transferred to magistrate of Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 改吏部員外郎，轉本司郎中，拜給事中。

translations.literal: He was reassigned as Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel, promoted to director of the same ministry, and appointed attending censor.
translations.idiomatic: He was reassigned as Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel, promoted to director of that ministry, and appointed attending censor.

sentences.zh: 出爲常州刺史。

translations.literal: He went out as prefect of Chang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed prefect of Chang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 夏卿深於儒術，所至招禮通經之士。

translations.literal: Xiaqing was deeply versed in Confucian learning; wherever he went, he recruited and honored scholars versed in the classics.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaqing was deeply learned in Confucian studies; wherever he served, he recruited and honored scholars versed in the classics.

sentences.zh: 時處士竇群寓於郡界，夏卿以其所著史論，薦之於朝，遂爲門人。

translations.literal: At that time the recluse Dou Qun was living within the prefectural boundary; Xiaqing recommended to the court his written Historical Discourse and took him as a disciple.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the recluse Dou Qun was living within the prefecture; Xiaqing recommended his Historical Discourse to the court and took him as a disciple.

sentences.zh: 改蘇州刺史。

translations.literal: He was reassigned as prefect of Su Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was reassigned as prefect of Su Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 貞元末，徐州張建封卒，初授夏卿徐州行軍司馬，尋授徐泗濠節度使。

translations.literal: At the end of the Zhenyuan era, Zhang Jianfeng of Xu Prefecture died. Xiaqing was first appointed Military Affairs Aide of Xu Prefecture, then soon appointed military commissioner of Xu, Si, and Hao.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Zhenyuan era, Zhang Jianfeng of Xu Prefecture died. Xiaqing was first appointed Military Affairs Aide of Xu Prefecture, then soon made military commissioner of Xu, Si, and Hao.

sentences.zh: 夏卿未至，建封子愔爲軍人立爲留後，因授旄鉞。

translations.literal: Before Xiaqing arrived, Jianfeng's son Yin was installed as acting commissioner by the troops, and was consequently granted the commissioner's insignia.
translations.idiomatic: Before Xiaqing arrived, Jianfeng's son Yin was installed as acting commissioner by the troops and was granted the commissioner's insignia.

sentences.zh: 征夏卿爲吏部侍郎，轉京兆尹、太子賓客，檢校工部尚書、東都留守，遷太子少保。

translations.literal: Xiaqing was summoned back as Vice Minister of Personnel, then transferred to metropolitan magistrate and Household Companion to the Heir Apparent, Acting Minister of Works and Eastern Capital commissioner, and promoted to Junior Mentor to the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaqing was recalled as Vice Minister of Personnel, then transferred to metropolitan magistrate and Household Companion to the Heir Apparent, Acting Minister of Works and Eastern Capital commissioner, and promoted to Junior Mentor to the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 卒時年六十四，贈左僕射。

translations.literal: He died at age sixty-four and was posthumously enfeoffed as Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He died at age sixty-four and was posthumously enfeoffed as Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 夏卿有風韻，善談宴，與人同處，終年而喜慍不形於色。

translations.literal: Xiaqing had personal grace and was skilled at conversation and banquets; living with others, he could pass a whole year without letting pleasure or anger show on his face.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaqing had personal grace and was skilled at conversation and banquets; living with others, he could pass a whole year without pleasure or anger showing on his face.

sentences.zh: 撫孤侄，恩逾己子，早有時稱。

translations.literal: He raised his orphaned nephew with kindness surpassing that for his own sons, earning early renown.
translations.idiomatic: He raised his orphaned nephew with kindness surpassing that shown his own sons, earning early renown.

sentences.zh: 其所與遊辟之賓佐，皆一時名士。

translations.literal: The guests and staff with whom he associated and whom he recruited were all celebrated men of the age.
translations.idiomatic: The guests and aides he associated with and recruited were all celebrated men of the age.

sentences.zh: 爲政務通適，不喜改作。

translations.literal: In governing he strove for practical adaptability and disliked needless changes.
translations.idiomatic: In governing he sought practical adaptability and disliked needless innovation.

sentences.zh: 始在東都，傾心辟士，頗得才彦，其後多至卿相，世謂之知人。

translations.literal: When he was first in the Eastern Capital, he devoted himself to recruiting talent and obtained many outstanding men; afterward many rose to ministerial rank, and the age called him a discerning judge of men.
translations.idiomatic: When he was first in the Eastern Capital, he devoted himself to recruiting talent and obtained many outstanding men; many later rose to ministerial rank, and the age called him a discerning judge of men.

sentences.zh: 王正雅，字光謙，其先太原尹東都留守翃之子。

translations.literal: Wang Zhengya, styled Guangqian, was descended from Hong, formerly metropolitan magistrate of Taiyuan and Eastern Capital commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhengya, styled Guangqian, was descended from Hong, formerly metropolitan magistrate of Taiyuan and Eastern Capital commissioner.

sentences.zh: 伯父翊，代宗朝御史大夫，以貞亮鯁直，名於當代，卒謚曰忠惠。

translations.literal: His father's elder brother Yi, Censor-in-Chief under Emperor Daizong, was renowned in his age for integrity and blunt uprightness; upon his death he was granted the posthumous title Loyal and Kind.
translations.idiomatic: His father's elder brother Yi, Censor-in-Chief under Emperor Daizong, was renowned in his age for integrity and blunt uprightness; upon his death he was granted the posthumous title Loyal and Kind.

sentences.zh: 正雅少時，以孝行修謹聞。

translations.literal: In his youth Zhengya was known for filial conduct and careful self-cultivation.
translations.idiomatic: In his youth Zhengya was known for filial conduct and careful self-cultivation.

sentences.zh: 元和初，舉進士，登甲科，禮部侍郎崔邠甚知之，累從職使府。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Yuanhe era he passed the jinshi examination with top honors; Vice Minister of Rites Cui Bin greatly appreciated him, and he successively served in various commissioners' staffs.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Yuanhe era he passed the jinshi examination with top honors. Vice Minister of Rites Cui Bin greatly appreciated him, and he successively served on various commissioners' staffs.

sentences.zh: 元和十一年，拜監察御史，三遷爲萬年縣令。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Yuanhe he was appointed investigating censor and, after three promotions, became magistrate of Wannian County.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year of Yuanhe he was appointed investigating censor and, after three promotions, became magistrate of Wannian County.

sentences.zh: 當穆宗時，京邑號爲難理，正雅抑強扶弱，政甚有聲。

translations.literal: Under Emperor Muzong, when the capital district was said to be hard to govern, Zhengya suppressed the strong and aided the weak; his administration won great renown.
translations.idiomatic: Under Emperor Muzong, when the capital district was said to be hard to govern, Zhengya suppressed the strong and aided the weak, and his administration won great renown.

sentences.zh: 會柳公綽爲京兆尹，上前褒稱，穆宗命以緋衣銀章，就縣宣賜。

translations.literal: When Liu Gongchuo was metropolitan magistrate, he praised Zhengya before the throne; Muzong ordered that scarlet robes and silver insignia be presented and conferred upon him at the county seat.
translations.idiomatic: When Liu Gongchuo was metropolitan magistrate, he praised Zhengya before the throne; Muzong ordered scarlet robes and silver insignia presented and conferred upon him at the county seat.

sentences.zh: 遷戸部郎中，尋加知臺雜事，再遷太常少卿，出爲汝州刺史，充本州防禦使。

translations.literal: He was promoted to director in the Ministry of Revenue, soon given additional charge of miscellaneous censorial affairs, then promoted again to Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and sent out as prefect of Ru Prefecture, serving also as defense commissioner of that prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to director in the Ministry of Revenue, soon given additional charge of miscellaneous censorial affairs, then promoted again to Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and sent out as prefect of Ru Prefecture, serving also as defense commissioner of that prefecture.

sentences.zh: 有中人爲監軍，怙權幹政，正雅不能堪，乃謝病免。

translations.literal: An eunuch served as army supervisor and, relying on power, meddled in government; unable to endure it, Zhengya pleaded illness and resigned.
translations.idiomatic: An eunuch served as army supervisor and, relying on power, meddled in government; unable to endure it, Zhengya pleaded illness and resigned.

sentences.zh: 入爲大理卿。

translations.literal: He entered service as grand councilor of the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: He entered service as grand councilor of the Court of Judicial Review.

sentences.zh: 會宋申錫事起，獄自内出，卒無證驗。

translations.literal: When the Song Shenxi case arose, the investigation came from within the palace, and in the end there was no corroborating evidence.
translations.idiomatic: When the Song Shenxi case arose, the investigation came from within the palace, and in the end there was no corroborating evidence.

sentences.zh: 是時王守澄之威權，鄭註之寵勢，雖宰相重臣，無敢顯言其事者。

translations.literal: At that time Wang Shoucheng's awe-inspiring power and Zheng Zhu's favored influence were such that even chancellors and senior ministers dared not speak openly of the matter.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Wang Shoucheng's awe-inspiring power and Zheng Zhu's favored influence were such that even chancellors and senior ministers dared not speak openly of the matter.

sentences.zh: 唯正雅與京兆尹崔綰上疎，請出造事者，付外考驗其事，別具狀聞。

translations.literal: Only Zhengya and metropolitan magistrate Cui Guan submitted memorials requesting that those who fabricated the case be handed over for external investigation and that a separate report be submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Only Zhengya and metropolitan magistrate Cui Guan submitted memorials requesting that those who fabricated the case be handed over for external investigation and that a separate report be submitted.

sentences.zh: 由是獄情稍緩，申錫止於貶官，中外翕然推重之。

translations.literal: Thereby the investigation eased somewhat; Shenxi was reduced only to demotion, and within and outside the court all alike admired and respected them.
translations.idiomatic: Thereby the investigation eased somewhat; Shenxi was demoted rather than punished more severely, and within and outside the court all alike admired and respected them.

sentences.zh: 太和五年十一月卒，贈左散騎常侍。

translations.literal: He died in the eleventh month of the fifth year of Taihe and was posthumously enfeoffed as Left Regular Attendant on Horseback.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the eleventh month of the fifth year of Taihe and was posthumously enfeoffed as Left Regular Attendant on Horseback.

sentences.zh: 正雅從弟重，翊之子也，位止河東令。

translations.literal: Zhengya's younger cousin Zhong, a son of Yi, rose no higher than magistrate of Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengya's younger cousin Zhong, a son of Yi, rose no higher than magistrate of Hedong.

sentences.zh: 重子衆仲，登進士第，累官衡州刺史。

translations.literal: Zhong's son Zhongzhong passed the jinshi examination and rose through successive offices to prefect of Heng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zhong's son Zhongzhong passed the jinshi examination and rose through successive offices to prefect of Heng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 衆仲子凝。

translations.literal: Zhongzhong's son was Ning.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongzhong's son was Ning.

sentences.zh: 凝，字致平，少孤，宰相鄭肅之甥，少依舅氏。

translations.literal: Ning, styled Zhiping, was orphaned young; he was the nephew of Chancellor Zheng Su and in youth relied on his maternal uncle's household.
translations.idiomatic: Ning, styled Zhiping, was orphaned young. He was the nephew of Chancellor Zheng Su and in youth relied on his maternal uncle's household.

sentences.zh: 年十五，兩經擢第。

translations.literal: At fifteen he passed both classics examinations.
translations.idiomatic: At fifteen he passed both classics examinations.

sentences.zh: 嘗著《京城六崗銘》，爲文士所稱。

translations.literal: He once wrote "Inscriptions on the Six Ridges of the Capital," which won praise from literati.
translations.idiomatic: He once wrote "Inscriptions on the Six Ridges of the Capital," which won praise from literati.

sentences.zh: 再登進士甲科。

translations.literal: He again passed the jinshi examination with top honors.
translations.idiomatic: He again passed the jinshi examination with top honors.

sentences.zh: 崔璪領鹽鐵，辟爲巡官。

translations.literal: When Cui Can headed the Salt and Iron Monopoly, he recruited Ning as touring official.
translations.idiomatic: When Cui Can headed the Salt and Iron Monopoly, he recruited Ning as touring official.

sentences.zh: 歴佐梓潼、宣歙使幕。

translations.literal: He successively served on the staffs of the Zitong and Xu-She commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: He successively served on the staffs of the Zitong and Xu-She commissioners.

sentences.zh: 宰相崔龜從奏爲鄠縣尉、集賢校理，遷監察御史，轉殿中。

translations.literal: Chancellor Cui Guicong recommended him as bailiff of Hu County and collator in the Hall of Assembled Worthies; he was promoted to investigating censor, then palace censor.
translations.idiomatic: Chancellor Cui Guicong recommended him as bailiff of Hu County and collator in the Hall of Assembled Worthies; he was promoted to investigating censor, then palace censor.

sentences.zh: 宰相崔鉉出鎭揚州，奏爲節度副使。

translations.literal: When Chancellor Cui Xuan went out to command Yang Prefecture, he recommended Ning as deputy military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: When Chancellor Cui Xuan went out to command Yang Prefecture, he recommended Ning as deputy military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 入爲起居郎，歴禮部、兵部、考功三員外。

translations.literal: He entered service as diarist and successively served as vice director in the Ministries of Rites and War and in the Bureau of Merit Evaluation.
translations.idiomatic: He entered service as diarist and successively served as vice director in the Ministries of Rites and War and in the Bureau of Merit Evaluation.

sentences.zh: 遷司封郎中、長安令。

translations.literal: He was promoted to director of the Bureau of Enfeoffments and magistrate of Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to director of the Bureau of Enfeoffments and magistrate of Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 中丞鄭處誨奏知臺雜，換考功郎中，遷中書舍人。

translations.literal: Censor-in-Chief Zheng Chuhui recommended him for additional charge of miscellaneous censorial affairs; he was transferred to director of the Bureau of Merit Evaluation, then promoted to drafting secretary in the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Censor-in-Chief Zheng Chuhui recommended him for additional charge of miscellaneous censorial affairs; he was transferred to director of the Bureau of Merit Evaluation, then promoted to drafting secretary in the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 時政不協，出爲同州刺史，賜金紫。

translations.literal: When court politics were discordant, he went out as prefect of Tong Prefecture and was granted gold and purple insignia.
translations.idiomatic: When court politics were discordant, he went out as prefect of Tong Prefecture and was granted gold and purple insignia.

sentences.zh: 暮年，移疾華州敷水別墅。

translations.literal: In his later years he transferred his illness to a villa at Fushui in Hua Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In his later years he retired to a villa at Fushui in Hua Prefecture on account of illness.

sentences.zh: 逾年，以禮部侍郎征。

translations.literal: After more than a year he was summoned as Vice Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: After more than a year he was summoned as Vice Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 凝性堅正，貢闈取士，拔其寒俊，而權豪請托不行，爲其所怒，出爲商州刺史。

translations.literal: Ning's character was firm and upright; in the examination hall he selected talented men from humble backgrounds and would not grant favors sought by powerful families, provoking their anger, and he was sent out as prefect of Shang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Ning's character was firm and upright. In the examination hall he selected talented men from humble backgrounds and refused favors sought by powerful families, provoking their anger; he was sent out as prefect of Shang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 明年，檢校右散騎常侍、潭州刺史、湖南團練觀察使。

translations.literal: The next year he was appointed Acting Right Regular Attendant on Horseback, prefect of Tan Prefecture, and training and observation commissioner of Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he was appointed Acting Right Regular Attendant on Horseback, prefect of Tan Prefecture, and training and observation commissioner of Hunan.

sentences.zh: 入爲兵部侍郎，領鹽鐵轉運使。

translations.literal: He entered service as Vice Minister of War and headed the Salt and Iron Transport Commission.
translations.idiomatic: He entered service as Vice Minister of War and headed the Salt and Iron Transport Commission.

sentences.zh: 又以不奉權幸，改秘書監。

translations.literal: Because again he would not court the powerful and favored, he was reassigned as director of the Imperial Archives.
translations.idiomatic: Because again he would not court the powerful and favored, he was reassigned as director of the Imperial Archives.

sentences.zh: 出爲河南尹、檢校禮部尚書、宣州刺史、宣歙觀察使。

translations.literal: He went out as metropolitan magistrate of Henan, Acting Minister of Rites, prefect of Xuan Prefecture, and observation commissioner of Xuan and She.
translations.idiomatic: He went out as metropolitan magistrate of Henan, Acting Minister of Rites, prefect of Xuan Prefecture, and observation commissioner of Xuan and She.

sentences.zh: 凝咸通中兩佐宣城使幕，備究人之利病，滌除積弊，民俗阜康。

translations.literal: During the Xiantong era Ning twice served on the staff of the Xuan Prefecture commissioner, thoroughly investigating people's gains and hardships, eliminating long-standing abuses, and bringing peace and prosperity to the customs of the region.
translations.idiomatic: During the Xiantong era Ning twice served on the staff of the Xuan Prefecture commissioner, thoroughly investigating people's gains and hardships, eliminating long-standing abuses, and bringing peace and prosperity to the region.

sentences.zh: 逾歳，黃巣自嶺表北歸，大掠淮南，攻圍和州。

translations.literal: After more than a year, Huang Chao returned north from the Lingnan region, ravaged Huainan on a large scale, and attacked and besieged He Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: After more than a year Huang Chao returned north from the Lingnan region, ravaged Huainan on a large scale, and attacked and besieged He Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 凝令牙將樊儔率師據采石以援之。

translations.literal: Ning ordered his guard general Fan Chou to lead troops to seize Caishi and aid it.
translations.idiomatic: Ning ordered his guard general Fan Chou to lead troops to seize Caishi and relieve the city.

sentences.zh: 儔犯令，凝即斬之以徇，命別將烏穎代儔赴援，竟解歴陽之圍。

translations.literal: Fan violated orders; Ning immediately executed him as a public warning, appointed the subordinate general Wu Ying to replace Fan in the relief effort, and ultimately lifted the siege of Liyang.
translations.idiomatic: Fan violated orders; Ning immediately executed him as a public warning, appointed the subordinate general Wu Ying to replace him in the relief effort, and ultimately lifted the siege of Liyang.

sentences.zh: 賊怒，引衆攻宣城。

translations.literal: Enraged, the rebels led their host to attack Xuan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Enraged, the rebels led their forces to attack Xuan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 大將王涓請出軍逆戰，凝曰：「賊忿恚而來，宜持重待之。

translations.literal: General Wang Juan requested to go out with the army to meet them in battle. Ning said, "The rebels come in fury and rage; we should hold firm and wait them out.
translations.idiomatic: General Wang Juan requested to go out with the army to meet them in battle. Ning said, "The rebels come in fury and rage; we should hold firm and wait them out.

sentences.zh: 彼衆我寡，萬一不捷，則州城危矣！」

translations.literal: They are many and we are few; if by any chance we do not prevail, then the prefectural city will be in peril!"
translations.idiomatic: They are many and we are few; if by any chance we do not prevail, the prefectural city will be in peril!"

sentences.zh: 涓鋭意請行，凝即閲集丁壯，分守要害，登陴設備。

translations.literal: Juan insisted on going forth; Ning immediately mustered able-bodied men, assigned them to guard key points, mounted the walls, and made preparations.
translations.idiomatic: Juan insisted on going forth; Ning immediately mustered able-bodied men, assigned them to guard key points, mounted the walls, and made preparations.

sentences.zh: 涓果戰死。

translations.literal: Juan was indeed killed in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Juan was indeed killed in battle.

sentences.zh: 賊乘勝而來，則守有備矣。

translations.literal: When the rebels came riding their victory, the defenders were already prepared.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels came riding their victory, the defenders were already prepared.

sentences.zh: 賊爲梯沖之具，急攻數月，禦備力殫，吏民請曰：「賊之兇勢不可當，願尚書歸款退之，懼覆尚書家族。」

translations.literal: The rebels made scaling ladders and battering rams and pressed the attack for months until defensive strength was exhausted; officials and people pleaded, "The rebels' ferocious momentum cannot be withstood; we beg the Minister to submit in good faith to send them away, fearing the destruction of your entire clan."
translations.idiomatic: The rebels made scaling ladders and battering rams and pressed the attack for months until defensive strength was exhausted. Officials and people pleaded, "The rebels' ferocious momentum cannot be withstood; we beg the Minister to submit in good faith to send them away, fearing the destruction of your entire clan."

sentences.zh: 凝曰：「人皆有族，予豈獨全？

translations.literal: Ning said, "All men have clans—why should I alone be preserved whole?
translations.idiomatic: Ning said, "All men have clans—why should I alone be preserved whole?

sentences.zh: 誓與此城同存亡也。」

translations.literal: I swear to share life and death with this city."
translations.idiomatic: I swear to share life and death with this city."

sentences.zh: 既而賊退去，時乾符五年也。

translations.literal: Before long the rebels withdrew; this was the fifth year of Qianfu.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the rebels withdrew; this was the fifth year of Qianfu.

sentences.zh: 其年夏，疾甚，有大星墜於正寢。

translations.literal: That summer his illness grew severe, and a great star fell into his principal chamber.
translations.idiomatic: That summer his illness grew severe, and a great star fell into his principal chamber.

sentences.zh: 八月卒於郡，時年五十八。

translations.literal: In the eighth month he died in the prefecture at age fifty-eight.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month he died in the prefecture at age fifty-eight.

sentences.zh: 無子，以弟子鑣爲嗣。

translations.literal: Having no sons, he made his younger brother's son Biao his heir.
translations.idiomatic: Having no sons, he made his younger brother's son Biao his heir.

sentences.zh: 鑣兄鉅，位終兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: Biao's elder brother Ju rose no higher than Vice Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: Biao's elder brother Ju rose no higher than Vice Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 柳公綽，字起之，京兆華原人也。

translations.literal: Liu Gongchuo, styled Qizhi, was a native of Huayuan in Jingzhao.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Gongchuo, styled Qizhi, was a native of Huayuan in Jingzhao.

sentences.zh: 祖正禮，邠州士曹參軍。

translations.literal: His grandfather Zhengli was a registrar of Shicao in Bin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Zhengli was a registrar of Shicao in Bin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 父子温，丹州刺史。

translations.literal: His father Ziwen was prefect of Dan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: His father Ziwen was prefect of Dan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 公綽幼聰敏。

translations.literal: Gongchuo was intelligent from childhood.
translations.idiomatic: Gongchuo was intelligent from childhood.

sentences.zh: 年十八，應制舉，登賢良方正、直言極諫科，授秘書省校書郎，貞元元年也。

translations.literal: At eighteen he took the imperial examination, passed the categories Incorrupt and Upright and Frank Counsel and Extreme Remonstrance, and was appointed collator in the Secretariat; this was the first year of Zhenyuan.
translations.idiomatic: At eighteen he took the imperial examination, passed the categories Incorrupt and Upright and Frank Counsel and Extreme Remonstrance, and was appointed collator in the Secretariat; this was the first year of Zhenyuan.

sentences.zh: 貞元四年，復應制舉，再登賢良方正科，時年二十一。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Zhenyuan he again took the imperial examination and passed the Incorrupt and Upright category at age twenty-one.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Zhenyuan he again took the imperial examination and passed the Incorrupt and Upright category at age twenty-one.

sentences.zh: 制出，授渭南尉。

translations.literal: When the edict was issued, he was appointed bailiff of Weinan.
translations.idiomatic: When the edict was issued, he was appointed bailiff of Weinan.

sentences.zh: 公綽性謹重，動循禮法。

translations.literal: Gongchuo's character was careful and solemn; in action he followed ritual and law.
translations.idiomatic: Gongchuo's character was careful and solemn; in action he followed ritual and law.

sentences.zh: 屬歳饑，其家雖給，而毎飯不過一器。

translations.literal: When famine came, although his household had provisions, at every meal he took no more than one bowl.
translations.idiomatic: When famine came, although his household had provisions, at every meal he took no more than one bowl.

sentences.zh: 歳稔復初。

translations.literal: When the harvest was good again, he returned to his former ways.
translations.idiomatic: When the harvest was good again, he returned to his former ways.

sentences.zh: 家甚貧，有書千巻，不讀非聖之書。

translations.literal: His family was very poor yet possessed a thousand scrolls; he would not read books that were not the works of sages.
translations.idiomatic: His family was very poor yet possessed a thousand scrolls; he would not read books that were not the works of sages.

sentences.zh: 爲文不尚浮靡。

translations.literal: In writing he did not prize florid extravagance.
translations.idiomatic: In writing he did not prize florid extravagance.

sentences.zh: 慈隰觀察使姚齊梧奏爲判官，得殿中侍御史。

translations.literal: Cizi observation commissioner Yao Qiwu recommended him as administrative aide and secured him the post of palace attendant censor.
translations.idiomatic: Cizi observation commissioner Yao Qiwu recommended him as administrative aide and secured him the post of palace attendant censor.

sentences.zh: 冬，薦授開州刺史，入爲侍御史，再遷吏部員外郎。

translations.literal: In winter he was recommended and appointed prefect of Kai Prefecture; he entered service as attendant censor and was again promoted to Vice Director in the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In winter he was recommended and appointed prefect of Kai Prefecture; he entered service as attendant censor and was again promoted to Vice Director in the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 武元衡罷相鎭西蜀，與裴度倶爲元衡判官，尤相善。

translations.literal: When Wu Yuanheng resigned the chancellorship to command western Shu, Pei Du and he together served as Yuanheng's aides and were especially close.
translations.idiomatic: When Wu Yuanheng resigned the chancellorship to command western Shu, Pei Du and he together served as Yuanheng's aides and were especially close.

sentences.zh: 先度入爲吏部郎中，度以詩餞別，有「兩人同日事征西，今日君先捧紫泥」之句。

translations.literal: Pei entered service first as director in the Ministry of Personnel; Pei presented a farewell poem with the line, "Both of us on the same day serve the western campaign—today it is you who first receives the purple decree."
translations.idiomatic: Pei entered service first as director in the Ministry of Personnel; Pei presented a farewell poem with the line, "Both of us on the same day serve the western campaign—today it is you who first receives the purple decree."

sentences.zh: 元和初，憲宗頗出遊畋，鋭意用兵；

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yuanhe, Emperor Xianzong frequently went out hunting and touring, and was intent on military campaigns;
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Yuanhe, Emperor Xianzong frequently went out hunting and touring, and was intent on military campaigns;

sentences.zh: 公綽欲因事諷諫。

translations.literal: Gongchuo wished to seize the occasion to offer indirect remonstrance.
translations.idiomatic: Gongchuo wished to seize the occasion to offer indirect remonstrance.

sentences.zh: 五年十一月，獻《太醫箴》一篇，其辭曰：

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the fifth year he submitted "Admonition of the Great Physician," which reads:
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the fifth year he submitted "Admonition of the Great Physician," which reads:

sentences.zh: 天布寒暑，不私於人。

translations.literal: Heaven spreads cold and heat and is partial to no one.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven spreads cold and heat and is partial to no one.

sentences.zh: 品類既一，崇髙以均。

translations.literal: Once all things share one kind, the high is honored to balance them.
translations.idiomatic: Once all things share one kind, the high is honored to balance them.

sentences.zh: 惟謹好愛，能保其身。

translations.literal: Only prudent cherishing and love can preserve one's person.
translations.idiomatic: Only prudent cherishing and love can preserve one's person.

sentences.zh: 淸凈無瑕，輝光以新。

translations.literal: Clear and pure without blemish, its radiance ever renewed.
translations.idiomatic: Clear and pure without blemish, its radiance ever renewed.

sentences.zh: 寒暑滿天地之間，浹肌膚於外；

translations.literal: Cold and heat fill heaven and earth and soak the skin from without;
translations.idiomatic: Cold and heat fill heaven and earth and soak the skin from without;

sentences.zh: 好愛溢耳目之前，誘心知於内。

translations.literal: Cherishing love overflows before eye and ear and tempts the mind within.
translations.idiomatic: Cherishing love overflows before eye and ear and tempts the mind within.

sentences.zh: 淸潔爲隄，奔射猶敗，氣行無章，隙不在大。

translations.literal: Purity is the dike; once rushing arrows pierce it, all is lost. When vital breath moves without order, the gap need not be large.
translations.idiomatic: Purity is the dike; once rushing arrows pierce it, all is lost. When vital breath moves without order, the gap need not be large.

sentences.zh: 睿聖之姿，淸明絶俗；

translations.literal: The countenance of sagely wisdom is clear and bright beyond the vulgar;
translations.idiomatic: The countenance of sagely wisdom is clear and bright beyond the vulgar;

sentences.zh: 心正無邪，志髙寡欲。

translations.literal: the heart upright without depravity, aspirations high and desires few.
translations.idiomatic: the heart upright without depravity, aspirations high and desires few.

sentences.zh: 謂天髙矣，氣蒙晦之；

translations.literal: One says heaven is high, yet breath can cloud and darken it;
translations.idiomatic: One says heaven is high, yet breath can cloud and darken it;

sentences.zh: 謂地厚矣，橫流潰之。

translations.literal: one says earth is thick, yet cross-flows can burst and breach it.
translations.idiomatic: one says earth is thick, yet cross-flows can burst and breach it.

sentences.zh: 聖德超邁，萬方賴之。

translations.literal: When sage virtue surpasses all bounds, the ten thousand regions rely upon it.
translations.idiomatic: When sage virtue surpasses all bounds, the ten thousand regions rely upon it.

sentences.zh: 飲食所以資身也，過則生患；

translations.literal: Food and drink sustain the body; excess breeds illness;
translations.idiomatic: Food and drink sustain the body; excess breeds illness;

sentences.zh: 衣服所以稱德也，侈則生慢。

translations.literal: clothing displays virtue; extravagance breeds arrogance.
translations.idiomatic: clothing displays virtue; extravagance breeds arrogance.

sentences.zh: 唯過與侈，心必隨之，氣與心流，疾亦伺之。

translations.literal: With excess and extravagance the heart surely follows; breath flows with the heart, and illness waits upon them.
translations.idiomatic: With excess and extravagance the heart surely follows; breath flows with the heart, and illness waits upon them.

sentences.zh: 聖心不惑，孰能移之？

translations.literal: If the sage heart is not misled, who can divert it?
translations.idiomatic: If the sage heart is not misled, who can divert it?

sentences.zh: 畋遊恣樂，流情蕩志；

translations.literal: Hunting and roaming in reckless pleasure dissipate feeling and unsettle purpose;
translations.idiomatic: Hunting and roaming in reckless pleasure dissipate feeling and unsettle purpose;

sentences.zh: 馳騁勞形，咤叱傷氣。

translations.literal: Galloping wearies the form; shouting harms the breath.
translations.idiomatic: Galloping wearies the form; shouting harms the breath.

sentences.zh: 惟天之重，從禽爲累。

translations.literal: For one who bears heaven's weight, chasing birds becomes a burden.
translations.idiomatic: For one who bears heaven's weight, chasing birds becomes a burden.

sentences.zh: 不養其外，前修所忌。

translations.literal: Failing to nurture the outer self is what past worthies dreaded.
translations.idiomatic: Failing to nurture the outer self is what past worthies dreaded.

sentences.zh: 聖心非之，孰敢違之。

translations.literal: When the sage heart rejects it, who dares disobey?
translations.idiomatic: When the sage heart rejects it, who dares disobey?

sentences.zh: 人乘氣生，嗜欲以萌，氣離有患，氣凝則成。

translations.literal: Humans live by riding breath; appetites arise and sprout. When breath disperses there is harm; when breath congeals, illness forms.
translations.idiomatic: Humans live by riding breath; appetites arise and sprout. When breath disperses there is harm; when breath congeals, illness forms.

sentences.zh: 巧必喪眞，智必誘情，去彼煩慮，在此誠明。

translations.literal: Craftiness must lose truth; cleverness must lure emotion—cast off those troubling thoughts, hold to this sincere clarity.
translations.idiomatic: Craftiness must lose truth; cleverness must lure emotion—cast off those troubling thoughts, hold to this sincere clarity.

sentences.zh: 醫之上者，理於未然，患居慮後，防處事先。

translations.literal: The supreme physician treats what is not yet ill, places illness after forethought, and stations defense before events.
translations.idiomatic: The supreme physician treats what is not yet ill, places illness after forethought, and stations defense before events.

sentences.zh: 心靜樂行，體和道全，然後能德施萬物，以享億年。

translations.literal: With a still heart, joyous conduct, bodily harmony, and the Way complete, one can then extend virtue to the myriad things and enjoy ten thousand years.
translations.idiomatic: With a still heart, joyous conduct, bodily harmony, and the Way complete, one can then extend virtue to the myriad things and enjoy ten thousand years.

sentences.zh: 聖人在上，各有攸處。

translations.literal: When the sage ruler is above, each has his proper place.
translations.idiomatic: When the sage ruler is above, each has his proper place.

sentences.zh: 庶政有官，群藝有署。

translations.literal: Common administration has its offices; the various arts have their bureaus.
translations.idiomatic: Common administration has its offices; the various arts have their bureaus.

sentences.zh: 臣司太醫，敢告諸禦。

translations.literal: Your servant oversees the Great Physician and ventures to inform all riders.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant oversees the Great Physician and ventures to inform all riders.

sentences.zh: 憲宗深嘉之。

translations.literal: Xianzong greatly praised it.
translations.idiomatic: Xianzong greatly praised it.

sentences.zh: 翌日，降中使獎勞之，曰：「卿所獻之文云：『氣行無間，隙不在大。』

translations.literal: The next day an imperial messenger was dispatched with commendation, saying, "In the text you submitted: 'When vital breath moves without order, the gap need not be large.'
translations.idiomatic: The next day an imperial messenger was dispatched with commendation, saying, "In the text you submitted: 'When vital breath moves without order, the gap need not be large.'

sentences.zh: 何憂朕之深也？」

translations.literal: How deeply you worry for me!"
translations.idiomatic: How deeply you worry for me!"

sentences.zh: 逾月，拜御史中丞。

translations.literal: After more than a month he was appointed Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: After more than a month he was appointed Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 公綽素與裴垍厚，李吉甫出鎭淮南，深怨垍。

translations.literal: Gongchuo had long been close to Pei Ji; when Li Jifu went out to command Huainan, he deeply resented Ji.
translations.idiomatic: Gongchuo had long been close to Pei Ji; when Li Jifu went out to command Huainan, he deeply resented Ji.

sentences.zh: 六年，吉甫復輔政，以公綽爲潭州刺史、兼御史中丞，充湖南觀察使。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, when Jifu again served as chancellor, he appointed Gongchuo prefect of Tan and concurrent Censor-in-Chief, as observation commissioner of Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, when Jifu again served as chancellor, he appointed Gongchuo prefect of Tan and concurrent Censor-in-Chief, as observation commissioner of Hunan.

sentences.zh: 湖南地氣卑濕，公綽以母在京師，不可迎侍，致書宰相，乞分司洛陽，以便奉養，久不許。

translations.literal: Hunan's climate was low and humid; because his mother was in the capital and could not be brought to him for care, Gongchuo wrote to the chancellor requesting assignment in Luoyang on detached duty to facilitate supporting her, but permission was long denied.
translations.idiomatic: Hunan's climate was low and humid. Because his mother was in the capital and could not be brought to him for care, Gongchuo wrote to the chancellor requesting assignment in Luoyang on detached duty to facilitate supporting her, but permission was long denied.

sentences.zh: 八年，移爲鄂州刺史、鄂嶽觀察使，乃迎母至江夏。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was transferred to prefect of E and observation commissioner of E and Yue, and then brought his mother to Jiangxia.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was transferred to prefect of E and observation commissioner of E and Yue, and then brought his mother to Jiangxia.

sentences.zh: 九年，呉元濟據蔡州叛，王師討伐。

translations.literal: In the ninth year Wu Yuanji seized Cai Prefecture and rebelled; the imperial army marched to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year Wu Yuanji seized Cai Prefecture and rebelled; the imperial army marched to suppress him.

sentences.zh: 詔公綽以鄂嶽兵五千隸安州刺史李聽，率赴行營。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Gongchuo to place five thousand E-Yue troops under An Prefecture prefect Li Ting and lead them to the campaign headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Gongchuo to place five thousand E-Yue troops under An Prefecture prefect Li Ting and lead them to the campaign headquarters.

sentences.zh: 公綽曰：「朝廷以吾儒生不知兵耶？」

translations.literal: Gongchuo said, "Does the court think that because I am a Confucian scholar I do not know warfare?"
translations.idiomatic: Gongchuo said, "Does the court think that because I am a Confucian scholar I do not know warfare?"

sentences.zh: 即日上奏，願自征行，許之。

translations.literal: That same day he submitted a memorial asking to campaign in person himself, and permission was granted.
translations.idiomatic: That same day he submitted a memorial asking to campaign in person himself, and permission was granted.

sentences.zh: 公綽自鄂濟湘江，直抵安州；

translations.literal: Gongchuo crossed the Xiang River from E and went straight to An Prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: Gongchuo crossed the Xiang River from E and went straight to An Prefecture;

sentences.zh: 李聽以廉使之禮事之。

translations.literal: Li Ting treated him with the courtesies due an observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Li Ting treated him with the courtesies due an observation commissioner.

sentences.zh: 公綽謂之曰：「公所以屬鞬負弩者，豈非爲兵事耶？

translations.literal: Gongchuo said to him, "The reason you were given command of bow-bearers and crossbowmen—is it not for military affairs?
translations.idiomatic: Gongchuo said to him, "The reason you were given command of bow-bearers and crossbowmen—is it not for military affairs?

sentences.zh: 若去戎容，被公服，兩郡守耳，何所統攝乎？

translations.literal: If you cast off martial dress and wear civilian robes, we are merely two prefects—what is there to command?
translations.idiomatic: If you cast off martial dress and wear civilian robes, we are merely two prefects—what is there to command?

sentences.zh: 以公名家曉兵，若吾不足以指麾，則當赴闕；

translations.literal: Coming from a famous family and understanding warfare, if I am not fit to give orders, then I should go to court;
translations.idiomatic: Coming from a famous family and understanding warfare, if I am not fit to give orders, then I should go to court;

sentences.zh: 不然，吾且署職名，以兵法從事矣。」

translations.literal: otherwise I shall post official titles and proceed according to military law."
translations.idiomatic: otherwise I shall post official titles and proceed according to military law."

sentences.zh: 聽曰：「唯公所命。」

translations.literal: Ting said, "I obey whatever you command."
translations.idiomatic: Ting said, "I obey whatever you command."

sentences.zh: 即署聽爲鄂嶽都知兵馬使、中軍先鋒、行營兵馬都虞候，三牒授之。

translations.literal: He immediately posted Ting as Chief of E-Yue Troops, vanguard of the central army, and chief controller of campaign forces, conferring three commissions.
translations.idiomatic: He immediately posted Ting as Chief of E-Yue Troops, vanguard of the central army, and chief controller of campaign forces, conferring three commissions.

sentences.zh: 乃選卒六千屬聽，戒其部校曰：「行營之事，一決都將。」

translations.literal: He then selected six thousand soldiers for Ting's command and admonished the officers, "All campaign matters are decided solely by the commanding general."
translations.idiomatic: He then selected six thousand soldiers for Ting's command and admonished the officers, "All campaign matters are decided solely by the commanding general."

sentences.zh: 聽感恩畏威，如出麾下。

translations.literal: Ting, grateful and awed, served as though under his own general's banner.
translations.idiomatic: Ting, grateful and awed, served as though under his own general's banner.

sentences.zh: 其知權制變，甚爲當時所稱。

translations.literal: His grasp of authority, system, and adaptation was greatly praised in his age.
translations.idiomatic: His grasp of authority, system, and adaptation was greatly praised in his age.

sentences.zh: 鄂軍既在行營，公綽時令左右省問其家。

translations.literal: Once the E troops were at campaign headquarters, Gongchuo regularly sent attendants to inquire after their families.
translations.idiomatic: Once the E troops were at campaign headquarters, Gongchuo regularly sent attendants to inquire after their families.

sentences.zh: 如疾病、養生、送死，必厚廩給之。

translations.literal: For illness, care in life, or burial upon death, he always gave generous allowances.
translations.idiomatic: For illness, care in life, or burial upon death, he always gave generous allowances.

sentences.zh: 軍士之妻治容不謹者，沈之於江。

translations.literal: Soldiers' wives who dressed immodestly were drowned in the river.
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers' wives who dressed immodestly were drowned in the river.

sentences.zh: 行卒相感曰：「中丞爲我輩知家事，何以報效？」

translations.literal: The marching soldiers were moved to say, "The Censor-in-Chief attends to our household affairs for us—how can we repay him?"
translations.idiomatic: The marching soldiers were moved to say, "The Censor-in-Chief attends to our household affairs for us—how can we repay him?"

sentences.zh: 故鄂人戰毎克捷。

translations.literal: Therefore the men of E won victory in every battle.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore the men of E won victory in every battle.

sentences.zh: 十一年，入爲給事中。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he entered service as Supervising Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he entered service as Supervising Secretary.

sentences.zh: 李師道歸朝，遣公綽往鄆州宣諭。

translations.literal: When Li Shidao submitted to the court, Gongchuo was dispatched to Yan Prefecture to proclaim the imperial will.
translations.idiomatic: When Li Shidao submitted to the court, Gongchuo was dispatched to Yan Prefecture to proclaim the imperial will.

sentences.zh: 使還，拜京兆尹，以母憂免。

translations.literal: Upon returning from his mission, he was appointed metropolitan magistrate but resigned on account of mourning for his mother.
translations.idiomatic: Upon returning from his mission, he was appointed metropolitan magistrate but resigned on account of mourning for his mother.

sentences.zh: 十四年，起爲刑部侍郎，領鹽鐵轉運使。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he was recalled as Vice Minister of Justice and headed the Salt and Iron Transport Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he was recalled as Vice Minister of Justice and headed the Salt and Iron Transport Commission.

sentences.zh: 轉兵部侍郎、兼御史大夫，領使如故。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Vice Minister of War and concurrent Censor-in-Chief while retaining his commission unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Vice Minister of War and concurrent Censor-in-Chief while retaining his commission unchanged.

sentences.zh: 長慶元年，罷使，復爲京兆尹、兼御史大夫。

translations.literal: In the first year of Changqing he was relieved of his commission and again served as metropolitan magistrate and concurrent Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Changqing he was relieved of his commission and again served as metropolitan magistrate and concurrent Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 時河朔復叛，朝廷用兵，補授行營諸將，朝令夕改，驛騎相望。

translations.literal: At that time Hebei rebelled again; the court waged war and appointed replacement generals for the campaign headquarters—orders changed morning and evening, and relay riders passed one after another.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Hebei rebelled again; the court waged war and appointed replacement generals for the campaign headquarters—orders changed morning and evening, and relay riders passed one after another.

sentences.zh: 公綽奏曰：「自幽、鎭用兵，使命繁並，館遞匱乏，鞍馬多闕。

translations.literal: Gongchuo memorialized, "Since the campaign in You and Zhen, missions have multiplied, postal stations and relays have been depleted, and saddled horses are greatly lacking.
translations.idiomatic: Gongchuo memorialized, "Since the campaign in You and Zhen, missions have multiplied, postal stations and relays have been depleted, and saddled horses are greatly lacking.

sentences.zh: 又敕使行李人數，都無限約。

translations.literal: Moreover, the number of attendants in imperial envoys' retinues is entirely unlimited.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, the number of attendants in imperial envoys' retinues is entirely unlimited.

sentences.zh: 其衣緋紫乘馬者，二十、三十匹，衣黃緑者，不下十匹、五匹。

translations.literal: Those wearing scarlet or purple who ride horses take twenty or thirty mounts; those in yellow and green take no fewer than ten or five.
translations.idiomatic: Those wearing scarlet or purple who ride horses take twenty or thirty mounts; those in yellow and green take no fewer than ten or five.

sentences.zh: 驛吏不得視券牒，隨口即供。

translations.literal: Postal clerks may not examine vouchers but must supply whatever is demanded on the spot.
translations.idiomatic: Postal clerks may not examine vouchers but must supply whatever is demanded on the spot.

sentences.zh: 驛馬既盡，遂奪路人鞍馬。

translations.literal: Once relay horses are exhausted, they seize saddled horses from passersby.
translations.idiomatic: Once relay horses are exhausted, they seize saddled horses from passersby.

sentences.zh: 衣冠士庶，驚擾怨嗟，遠近喧騰，行李將絶。

translations.literal: Officials and commoners alike are alarmed, distressed, and resentful; near and far there is uproar, and provisions for travel are nearly exhausted.
translations.idiomatic: Officials and commoners alike are alarmed, distressed, and resentful; near and far there is uproar, and provisions for travel are nearly exhausted.

sentences.zh: 伏望聖慈，聊爲定限。」

translations.literal: I humbly hope for sacred compassion to set some limits."
translations.idiomatic: I humbly hope for sacred compassion to set some limits."

sentences.zh: 乃下中書條疎人數。

translations.literal: Thereupon the Secretariat issued detailed regulations on numbers of personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the Secretariat issued detailed regulations on numbers of personnel.

sentences.zh: 自是吏不告勞。

translations.literal: From this the clerks no longer complained of exhaustion.
translations.idiomatic: From this the clerks no longer complained of exhaustion.

sentences.zh: 以言直爲北司所惡，尋轉吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: Because his outspokenness offended the Northern Bureau, he was soon transferred to Vice Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Because his outspokenness offended the Northern Bureau, he was soon transferred to Vice Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 二年九月，遷御史大夫。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the second year he was promoted to Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the second year he was promoted to Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 韓弘病，自河中入朝。

translations.literal: Han Hong fell ill and came to court from Hezhong.
translations.idiomatic: Han Hong fell ill and came to court from Hezhong.

sentences.zh: 以弘守司徒、中書令，詔百僚問疾。

translations.literal: Because Hong held the posts of Minister of Education and Chief Minister of the Secretariat, an edict ordered all officials to inquire after his health.
translations.idiomatic: Because Hong held the posts of Minister of Education and Chief Minister of the Secretariat, an edict ordered all officials to inquire after his health.

sentences.zh: 弘遣其子達情，言不能接見。

translations.literal: Hong sent his son to convey that he was unable to receive visitors.
translations.idiomatic: Hong sent his son to convey that he was unable to receive visitors.

sentences.zh: 公綽謂其子曰：「聖上以公官重，令百司省問，異禮也。

translations.literal: Gongchuo told his son, "The Sage Lord, considering your father's high rank, ordered all bureaus to inquire after him—this is exceptional courtesy.
translations.idiomatic: Gongchuo told his son, "The Sage Lord, considering your father's high rank, ordered all bureaus to inquire after him—this is exceptional courtesy.

sentences.zh: 如拜君賜，宜力疾公見。

translations.literal: As though receiving the sovereign's gift, he should strain his illness and receive visitors openly.
translations.idiomatic: As though receiving the sovereign's gift, he should strain his illness and receive visitors openly.

sentences.zh: 安有臥令子弟傳言耶？」

translations.literal: How can one lie abed and send children to speak for him?"
translations.idiomatic: How can one lie abed and send children to speak for him?"

sentences.zh: 弘懼，挾扶而出，人皆聳然。

translations.literal: Hong feared this and, supported on both sides, went out; all were startled.
translations.idiomatic: Hong feared this and, supported on both sides, went out; all were startled.

sentences.zh: 三年，改尚書左丞，又拜檢校戸部尚書、襄州刺史、山南東道節度使。

translations.literal: In the third year he was reassigned as Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and appointed Acting Minister of Revenue, prefect of Xiang Prefecture, and military commissioner of Shannan East Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was reassigned as Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and appointed Acting Minister of Revenue, prefect of Xiang Prefecture, and military commissioner of Shannan East Circuit.

sentences.zh: 行部至鄧縣，縣二吏犯法，一贓賄，一舞文。

translations.literal: On an inspection tour at Deng County, two clerks had broken the law—one for bribery, one for twisting documents.
translations.idiomatic: On an inspection tour at Deng County, two clerks had broken the law—one for bribery, one for twisting documents.

sentences.zh: 縣令以公綽守法，必殺贓吏。

translations.literal: The magistrate thought that because Gongchuo upheld the law, he would surely execute the bribe-taking clerk.
translations.idiomatic: The magistrate thought that because Gongchuo upheld the law, he would surely execute the bribe-taking clerk.

sentences.zh: 獄具，判之曰：「贓吏犯法，法在；

translations.literal: When the case was complete, he judged, "The bribe-taking clerk broke the law—the law remains;
translations.idiomatic: When the case was complete, he judged, "The bribe-taking clerk broke the law—the law remains;

sentences.zh: 奸吏壞法，法亡。

translations.literal: the scheming clerk destroyed the law—the law perishes.
translations.idiomatic: the scheming clerk destroyed the law—the law perishes.

sentences.zh: 誅舞文者。」

translations.literal: Execute the one who twisted documents."
translations.idiomatic: Execute the one who twisted documents."

sentences.zh: 公綽馬害圉人，命斬之。

translations.literal: Gongchuo's horse injured a groom; he ordered the horse killed.
translations.idiomatic: Gongchuo's horse injured a groom; he ordered the horse killed.

sentences.zh: 賓客進言曰：「可惜良馬，圉人自防不至。」

translations.literal: Guests urged, "It is a pity to lose a fine horse—the groom failed to guard himself."
translations.idiomatic: Guests urged, "It is a pity to lose a fine horse—the groom failed to guard himself."

sentences.zh: 公綽曰：「安有良馬害人乎？」

translations.literal: Gongchuo said, "How can there be a fine horse that harms people?"
translations.idiomatic: Gongchuo said, "How can there be a fine horse that harms people?"

sentences.zh: 亟命殺之。

translations.literal: He immediately ordered it killed.
translations.idiomatic: He immediately ordered it killed.

sentences.zh: 牛僧孺罷相鎭江夏，公綽具戎容，於郵舍候之。

translations.literal: When Niu Sengru resigned the chancellorship to command Jiangxia, Gongchuo donned full military dress and waited for him at the postal station.
translations.idiomatic: When Niu Sengru resigned the chancellorship to command Jiangxia, Gongchuo donned full military dress and waited for him at the postal station.

sentences.zh: 軍吏自以漢上地髙於鄂，禮太過。

translations.literal: His military officers thought that since the Han River region was higher in status than E, the courtesy was excessive.
translations.idiomatic: His military officers thought that since the Han River region was higher in status than E, the courtesy was excessive.

sentences.zh: 公綽曰：「奇章才離臺席，方鎭重宰相，是尊朝廷也。」

translations.literal: Gongchuo said, "Qizhang has just left the council dais; for a frontier commissioner to honor a chancellor is to honor the court."
translations.idiomatic: Gongchuo said, "Qizhang has just left the council dais; for a frontier commissioner to honor a chancellor is to honor the court."

sentences.zh: 竟以戎容見。

translations.literal: In the end he received him in full military dress.
translations.idiomatic: In the end he received him in full military dress.

sentences.zh: 有道士獻丹藥，試之有驗，問所從來，曰：「煉此丹於薊門。」

translations.literal: A Daoist presented elixir pills; tested, they proved effective. Asked where they came from, he said, "I refined this elixir at Jimen."
translations.idiomatic: A Daoist presented elixir pills; tested, they proved effective. Asked where they came from, he said, "I refined this elixir at Jimen."

sentences.zh: 時硃克融方叛，公綽遽謂之曰：「惜哉，至藥來於賊臣之境，雖驗何益！」

translations.literal: At that time Zhu Kerong had just rebelled; Gongchuo immediately said to him, "What a pity—even the finest medicine comes from the land of rebel ministers; though it proves effective, what good is it!"
translations.idiomatic: At that time Zhu Kerong had just rebelled; Gongchuo immediately said to him, "What a pity—even the finest medicine comes from the land of rebel ministers; though it proves effective, what good is it!"

sentences.zh: 乃沈之於江，而逐道士。

translations.literal: He then sank them in the river and expelled the Daoist.
translations.idiomatic: He then sank them in the river and expelled the Daoist.

sentences.zh: 鄧縣人鄭懷政病狂，妄稱天子，公綽捕而殺之。

translations.literal: Zheng Huaizheng of Deng County, maddened by illness, falsely declared himself Son of Heaven; Gongchuo arrested and executed him.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Huaizheng of Deng County, maddened by illness, falsely declared himself Son of Heaven; Gongchuo arrested and executed him.

sentences.zh: 敬宗即位，加檢校左僕射。

translations.literal: When Emperor Jingzong took the throne, he was given the additional title Acting Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Jingzong took the throne, he was given the additional title Acting Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 寶暦元年，入爲刑部尚書。

translations.literal: In the first year of Baoli he entered service as Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Baoli he entered service as Minister of Justice.

sentences.zh: 二年，授邠州刺史、邠寧慶節度使。

translations.literal: In the second year he was appointed prefect of Bin and military commissioner of Bin, Ning, and Qing.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was appointed prefect of Bin and military commissioner of Bin, Ning, and Qing.

sentences.zh: 所部有神策諸鎭，屯列要地，承前不受節度使制置，遂致北虜深入。

translations.literal: Within his jurisdiction were several Shence Army garrisons stationed at key points; by precedent they did not accept the military commissioner's authority, and consequently northern barbarians penetrated deep.
translations.idiomatic: Within his jurisdiction were several Shence Army garrisons stationed at key points; by precedent they did not accept the military commissioner's authority, and consequently northern barbarians penetrated deep.

sentences.zh: 公綽上疎論之，因詔諸鎭皆稟邠寧節度使制置。

translations.literal: Gongchuo memorialized on the matter; consequently an edict ordered all garrisons to obey the Bin-Ning military commissioner's disposition.
translations.idiomatic: Gongchuo memorialized on the matter; consequently an edict ordered all garrisons to obey the Bin-Ning military commissioner's disposition.

sentences.zh: 三年，入爲刑部尚書，京兆人有姑鞭婦致死者，府斷以償死。

translations.literal: In the third year he entered service as Minister of Justice. In Jingzhao, a mother-in-law flogged her daughter-in-law to death; the prefecture sentenced death in compensation.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he entered service as Minister of Justice. In Jingzhao, a mother-in-law flogged her daughter-in-law to death; the prefecture sentenced death in compensation.

sentences.zh: 公綽議曰：「尊毆卑非鬥，且其子在，以妻而戮其母，非教也。」

translations.literal: Gongchuo argued, "Beating by a superior against an inferior is not mutual combat; moreover, with her son still living, to execute the mother because of the wife is not instructional."
translations.idiomatic: Gongchuo argued, "Beating by a superior against an inferior is not mutual combat; moreover, with her son still living, to execute the mother because of the wife is not instructional."

sentences.zh: 竟減死。

translations.literal: In the end the sentence was reduced from death.
translations.idiomatic: In the end the death sentence was commuted.

sentences.zh: 太和四年，復檢校左僕射、太原尹、北都留守、河東節度觀察等使。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Taihe, he was again made acting Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, Governor of Taiyuan, Northern Capital Garrison Commander, and Military Governor and Inspector of Hedong and other posts.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Taihe, he was again appointed acting Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, Governor of Taiyuan, Northern Capital Garrison Commander, and Military Governor and Inspector of Hedong.

sentences.zh: 是歳，北虜遣梅祿將軍李暢以馬萬匹來市，托雲入貢。

translations.literal: That year the northern barbarians sent General Li Chang of the Meilu command with ten thousand horses to trade, claiming it was tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year the northern tribes sent Meilu General Li Chang with ten thousand horses to sell, passing it off as tribute.

sentences.zh: 所經州府，守帥假之禮分，嚴其兵備。

translations.literal: At every prefecture and circuit he passed through, the defending commanders extended him ceremonial honors and tightened their military preparations.
translations.idiomatic: At every prefecture and circuit along the route, local commanders extended him full ceremonial honors and tightened their military defenses.

sentences.zh: 留館則戒卒於外，懼其襲奪。

translations.literal: When he lodged at a post station they posted guards outside, fearing a surprise seizure.
translations.idiomatic: When he stayed at relay stations, guards were posted outside, fearing he might seize the place by surprise.

sentences.zh: 太原故事，出兵迎之。

translations.literal: By Taiyuan custom, troops were sent out to welcome him.
translations.idiomatic: By Taiyuan custom, troops were sent out to receive him.

sentences.zh: 暢及界上，公綽使牙將祖考恭單馬勞問，待以修好之意。

translations.literal: When Chang reached the border, Gongchuo sent his adjutant Zu Kaogong alone on horseback to offer greetings and treat him with the intent of restoring good relations.
translations.idiomatic: When Chang reached the border, Gongchuo sent his adjutant Zu Kaogong alone on horseback to greet him and receive him with an eye to restoring friendly relations.

sentences.zh: 暢感義出涕，徐驅道中，不妄馳獵。

translations.literal: Moved by this righteousness, Chang wept; he drove slowly along the road and did not recklessly hunt or gallop.
translations.idiomatic: Touched by this courtesy, Chang wept; he rode slowly along the road and did not hunt or gallop recklessly.

sentences.zh: 及至，辟牙門，令譯引謁，宴以常禮。

translations.literal: When he arrived, the side gate was opened and an interpreter was ordered to lead him in for audience; he was entertained with ordinary ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: When he arrived, the side gate was opened, an interpreter was sent to conduct him in for audience, and he was entertained with ordinary ceremony.

sentences.zh: 及市馬而還，不敢侵犯。

translations.literal: When he returned after purchasing horses, he dared not commit any encroachment.
translations.idiomatic: When he returned after buying the horses, he did not dare commit any violation.

sentences.zh: 陘北有沙陁部落，自九姓、六州皆畏避之。

translations.literal: North of the Taihang Mountains there was the Shatuo tribe; the Nine Surnames and Six Prefectures all feared and avoided them.
translations.idiomatic: North of the Taihang Mountains lived the Shatuo tribe, whom the Nine Surnames and Six Prefectures all feared and avoided.

sentences.zh: 公綽至鎭，召其酋硃耶執宜，直抵雲、朔塞下，治廢柵十一所，募兵三千付之，留屯塞上，以禦匈奴。

translations.literal: When Gongchuo reached his post, he summoned their chieftain Zhuye Chiyi, went straight to the passes below Yun and Shuozhou, restored eleven abandoned stockades, recruited three thousand soldiers and entrusted them to him, and left them garrisoned on the frontier to defend against the Xiongnu.
translations.idiomatic: On taking up his post, Gongchuo summoned their chieftain Zhuye Chiyi, went straight to the passes below Yun and Shuozhou, restored eleven abandoned stockades, recruited three thousand soldiers and placed them under his command, and left them garrisoned on the frontier to hold off the northern raiders.

sentences.zh: 其妻母來太原者，請梁國夫人對酒食問遺之。

translations.literal: When his wife and mother came to Taiyuan, he had Lady of Liang State receive them with wine and food and send them gifts.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhuye's wife and mother came to Taiyuan, Gongchuo had Lady of Liang State receive them with wine and food and send them gifts of inquiry.

sentences.zh: 沙陁感之，深得其效。

translations.literal: The Shatuo were moved by this and served him with deep effectiveness.
translations.idiomatic: Deeply moved, the Shatuo served him with great loyalty.

sentences.zh: 六年，以病求代。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, he requested a replacement on account of illness.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he asked to be relieved on account of illness.

sentences.zh: 三月，授兵部尚書，征還京師。

translations.literal: In the third month he was appointed Minister of War and summoned back to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month he was appointed Minister of War and recalled to the capital.

sentences.zh: 四月卒，贈太子太保，謚曰成。

translations.literal: In the fourth month he died; he was posthumously made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, with the posthumous title Cheng.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the fourth month and was posthumously made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, with the posthumous title Cheng.

sentences.zh: 公綽天資仁孝，初丁母崔夫人之喪，三年不沐浴。

translations.literal: Gongchuo was by nature benevolent and filial; when he first completed mourning for his mother, Lady Cui, he did not bathe for three years.
translations.idiomatic: Gongchuo was naturally benevolent and filial; when he first mourned his mother, Lady Cui, he did not bathe for three years.

sentences.zh: 事繼親薛氏三十年，姻戚不知公綽非薛氏所生。

translations.literal: He served his stepmother, the Xue clan, for thirty years, and even kinsmen by marriage did not know that Gongchuo was not born of the Xue.
translations.idiomatic: He served his stepmother of the Xue clan for thirty years, and even his in-laws did not know he was not her son by birth.

sentences.zh: 外兄薛宮早卒，一女孤，配張毅夫，資遺甚於己子。

translations.literal: His maternal cousin Xue Gong died early, leaving a lone daughter; he married her to Zhang Yifu and provided for her more generously than for his own sons.
translations.idiomatic: His maternal cousin Xue Gong died young, leaving an orphaned daughter; Gongchuo married her to Zhang Yifu and provided for her more generously than for his own sons.

sentences.zh: 性端介寡合，與錢微、蔣乂、杜元穎、薛存誠文雅相知，交情款密。

translations.literal: His nature was upright and aloof, ill suited to easy company; with Qian Wei, Jiang Yi, Du Yuanying, and Xue Chengcheng he shared refined friendship, and their bonds were warm and close.
translations.idiomatic: Upright and reserved by nature, he was close to Qian Wei, Jiang Yi, Du Yuanying, and Xue Chengcheng in refined friendship, and their bonds ran deep.

sentences.zh: 凡六開府幕，得人尤盛。

translations.literal: In all he opened six prefectural staffs, and the men he obtained were especially numerous.
translations.idiomatic: In all he opened six prefectural staffs, and the talent he gathered was especially impressive.

sentences.zh: 錢徽掌貢之年，鄭朗覆落，公綽將赴襄陽，首辟之，朗竟爲名相。

translations.literal: In the year Qian Hui oversaw the examinations, Zheng Lang failed the re-examination; Gongchuo, about to go to Xiangyang, first recruited him, and Lang in the end became a celebrated chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: In the year Qian Hui oversaw the examinations, Zheng Lang failed the re-examination; Gongchuo, on his way to Xiangyang, recruited him first, and Lang eventually became a celebrated chancellor.

sentences.zh: 盧簡辭、崔玙、夏侯孜、韋長、李續、李拭，皆至公卿。

translations.literal: Lu Jianci, Cui Yu, Xiahou Zi, Wei Chang, Li Xu, and Li Shi all rose to ministerial rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Jianci, Cui Yu, Xiahou Zi, Wei Chang, Li Xu, and Li Shi all rose to the highest offices.

sentences.zh: 爲吏部侍郎，與舅左丞崔從同省，人士榮之。

translations.literal: As Vice Minister of the Civil Office, he served in the same ministry as his uncle, Left Vice Director Cui Cong, and the gentlemen of the court took pride in it.
translations.idiomatic: As Vice Minister of the Civil Office he served in the same ministry as his uncle, Left Vice Director Cui Cong—a distinction the court took pride in.

sentences.zh: 子仲郢，弟公權、公諒。

translations.literal: His son was Zhong Ying; his younger brothers were Gongquan and Gongliang.
translations.idiomatic: His son was Zhong Ying; his younger brothers were Gongquan and Gongliang.

sentences.zh: 仲郢，字諭蒙，元和十三年進士擢第，釋褐秘書省校書郎。

translations.literal: Zhong Ying, styled Yumeng, passed the jinshi examination in the thirteenth year of Yuanhe and on leaving office became a proofreader in the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Zhong Ying, styled Yumeng, passed the jinshi examination in the thirteenth year of Yuanhe and took his first post as proofreader in the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 牛僧孺鎭江夏，辟爲從事。

translations.literal: When Niu Sengru governed Jiangxia, he recruited Zhong Ying as an aide.
translations.idiomatic: When Niu Sengru governed Jiangxia, he recruited Zhong Ying as an aide.

sentences.zh: 仲郢有父風，動修禮法，僧孺嘆曰：「非積習名教，安能及此！」

translations.literal: Zhong Ying had his father's manner and always observed ritual propriety; Niu Sengru sighed: "Without long cultivation in the teachings of civilized virtue, how could one reach this!"
translations.idiomatic: Zhong Ying had his father's bearing and always observed ritual propriety; Niu Sengru sighed, "Without long cultivation in civilized teaching, how could one reach this!"

sentences.zh: 入爲監察御史。

translations.literal: He entered service as an investigating censor.
translations.idiomatic: He entered service as an investigating censor.

sentences.zh: 五年，遷侍御史。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was transferred to attendant censor.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was promoted to attendant censor.

sentences.zh: 富平縣人李秀才，籍在禁軍，誣鄕人斫父墓柏，射殺之。

translations.literal: A Licentiate Li of Fuping County, registered in the Palace Corps, falsely accused a fellow townsman of cutting the cypress at his father's tomb and shot and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: A Licentiate Li of Fuping County, enrolled in the Palace Corps, falsely accused a neighbor of cutting the cypress at his father's tomb and shot him dead.

sentences.zh: 法司以專殺論。

translations.literal: The judicial office judged the case as unauthorized killing.
translations.idiomatic: The judicial office judged the case as unauthorized killing.

sentences.zh: 文宗以中官所庇，決杖配流。

translations.literal: Because the Licentiate was protected by palace eunuchs, Emperor Wenzong ordered beating with the rod and banishment.
translations.idiomatic: Because the Licentiate was protected by palace eunuchs, Emperor Wenzong ordered him beaten with the rod and banished.

sentences.zh: 右補闕蔣系上疎論之，不省。

translations.literal: Right Supplementation Censor Jiang Xi submitted a memorial on the matter, but it was not heeded.
translations.idiomatic: Right Supplementation Censor Jiang Xi submitted a memorial protesting the decision, but it went unheeded.

sentences.zh: 仲郢執奏曰：「聖王作憲，殺人有必死之令；

translations.literal: Zhong Ying firmly memorialized: "When a sage king makes law, there is a command that murderers must die;
translations.idiomatic: Zhong Ying firmly memorialized, "When a sage king makes law, murder carries a mandatory death sentence;

sentences.zh: 聖明在上，當官無壞法之臣。

translations.literal: with a sage and enlightened ruler above, no official in office should be one who breaks the law.
translations.idiomatic: with a sage ruler above, no serving official should be one who breaks the law.

sentences.zh: 今秀才犯殺人之科，愚臣備監決之任，此賊不死，是亂典章。

translations.literal: Now the Licentiate has violated the statute for murder; I, your humble servant, am charged with supervising the execution. If this criminal does not die, the statutes are thrown into disorder.
translations.idiomatic: Now the Licentiate has violated the statute for murder, and I, your humble servant, am charged with supervising the execution. If this criminal does not die, the statutes are thrown into disorder.

sentences.zh: 臣雖至微，豈敢曠職？

translations.literal: Though I am utterly insignificant, how dare I neglect my duty?
translations.idiomatic: Though I am utterly insignificant, how dare I neglect my duty?

sentences.zh: 其秀才未敢行決，望別降敕處分。」

translations.literal: The Licentiate has not yet been executed; I beg that a separate edict be issued to dispose of the matter."
translations.idiomatic: The Licentiate has not yet been executed; I beg that a separate edict be issued to dispose of the matter."

sentences.zh: 乃詔御史蕭傑監之。

translations.literal: Thereupon the emperor ordered Censor Xiao Jie to supervise the execution.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor then ordered Censor Xiao Jie to supervise the execution.

sentences.zh: 傑又執奏。

translations.literal: Jie again firmly memorialized.
translations.idiomatic: Jie again submitted a firm memorial.

sentences.zh: 帝遂詔京兆府行決，不用監之。

translations.literal: The emperor then ordered the metropolitan government to carry out the execution without supervision.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor then ordered the metropolitan government to carry out the execution without supervision.

sentences.zh: 然朝廷嘉其守法。

translations.literal: Yet the court praised him for upholding the law.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the court praised both men for upholding the law.

sentences.zh: 會昌中，三遷吏部郎中，李德裕頗知之。

translations.literal: In the Huichang era he was thrice promoted to Director in the Ministry of the Civil Office, and Li Deyu came to know him well.
translations.idiomatic: In the Huichang era he was promoted three times to Director in the Ministry of the Civil Office, and Li Deyu came to know him well.

sentences.zh: 武宗有詔減冗官，吏部條疎，欲牒天下州府取額外官員。

translations.literal: Emperor Wuzong issued an edict to reduce redundant officials; the Ministry of the Civil Office drew up a plan to dispatch documents to prefectures and circuits throughout the realm to collect supernumerary officials.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wuzong issued an edict to reduce redundant officials; the Ministry of the Civil Office drew up a plan to dispatch documents to every prefecture and circuit to collect supernumerary officials.

sentences.zh: 仲郢曰：「諸州毎冬申闕，何煩牒耶？」

translations.literal: Zhong Ying said: "Every winter the prefectures report their vacancies—why trouble ourselves with dispatches?"
translations.idiomatic: Zhong Ying said, "Every winter the prefectures report their vacancies—why bother with dispatches?"

sentences.zh: 幸門頓塞。

translations.literal: The avenue of favor-seeking was suddenly blocked.
translations.idiomatic: The avenue of favor-seeking was suddenly cut off.

sentences.zh: 仲郢條理旬日，減一千二百員，時議爲愜。

translations.literal: Zhong Ying organized the matter in ten days and reduced twelve hundred posts; contemporary opinion found it satisfying.
translations.idiomatic: Zhong Ying organized the matter in ten days and eliminated twelve hundred posts; public opinion found it deeply satisfying.

sentences.zh: 遷諫議大夫。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Grand Master of Remonstrance.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Grand Master of Remonstrance.

sentences.zh: 五年，準南奏呉湘獄，御史崔元藻覆按得罪。

translations.literal: In the fifth year Huainan reported the Wu Xiang case, and Investigating Censor Cui Yuanzao, sent to re-examine it, was punished.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year Huainan reported the Wu Xiang case, and Investigating Censor Cui Yuanzao, sent to re-examine it, was punished.

sentences.zh: 仲郢上疎理之，人皆危懼。

translations.literal: Zhong Ying submitted a memorial in his defense, and everyone was alarmed for him.
translations.idiomatic: Zhong Ying submitted a memorial defending Yuanzao, and everyone feared for him.

sentences.zh: 德裕知其無私，益重之。

translations.literal: Deyu knew he acted without private motive and valued him all the more.
translations.idiomatic: Deyu knew he acted without private motive and esteemed him all the more.

sentences.zh: 武宗築望仙臺，仲郢累疎切諫。

translations.literal: Emperor Wuzong built the Terrace of Gazing at Immortals, and Zhong Ying repeatedly submitted forceful memorials in protest.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wuzong built the Terrace of Gazing at Immortals, Zhong Ying repeatedly submitted forceful memorials in protest.

sentences.zh: 帝召諭之曰：「聊因舊趾增葺，愧卿忠言。」

translations.literal: The emperor summoned and instructed him: "I am only adding to and repairing the old site; I am ashamed before your loyal words."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor summoned and reassured him, "I am only adding to and repairing the old site; I am ashamed before your loyal words."

sentences.zh: 德裕奏爲京兆尹，謝日，言曰：「下官不期太尉恩獎及此，仰報厚德，敢不如奇章門館。」

translations.literal: Deyu recommended him as metropolitan governor; on the day of thanksgiving for the appointment he spoke: "Your subordinate did not expect the Grand Marshal's gracious reward to reach this far; looking up to repay your great kindness, how dare I fail to match the Qizhang gatehouse!"
translations.idiomatic: Deyu recommended him as metropolitan governor; on the day he thanked the throne for the appointment he said, "Your subordinate did not expect the Grand Marshal's gracious reward to reach this far; to repay your great kindness, how could I fail to match the loyalty I showed in Niu Sengru's household?"

sentences.zh: 德裕不以爲嫌。

translations.literal: Deyu did not take it amiss.
translations.idiomatic: Deyu did not take offense.

sentences.zh: 時廢浮圖法，以銅像鑄錢。

translations.literal: At that time the Buddhist law was abolished and bronze images were cast into coin.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Buddhist law was abolished and bronze images were melted down for coin.

sentences.zh: 仲郢爲京畿鑄錢使，錢工欲於模加新字；

translations.literal: Zhong Ying served as coinage commissioner for the capital region; the mint workers wished to add new characters to the molds;
translations.idiomatic: Zhong Ying served as coinage commissioner for the capital region; the mint workers wished to add new characters to the molds;

sentences.zh: 仲郢止之，唯淮南加新字，後竟爲僧人取之爲像設鐘罄。

translations.literal: Zhong Ying stopped them; only Huainan added new characters, and in the end monks took them back to make image stands, bells, and chimes.
translations.idiomatic: Zhong Ying stopped them. Only Huainan added new characters, and in the end monks reclaimed the metal for image stands, bells, and chimes.

sentences.zh: 紇幹臯訴表甥劉詡毆母，詡爲禁軍小校，仲郢不俟奏下，杖殺。

translations.literal: Qogan Gao accused his cousin on his mother's side, Liu Xu, of beating his mother; Xu was a junior officer in the Palace Corps, and Zhong Ying, without waiting for the memorial to be approved, had him beaten to death.
translations.idiomatic: Qogan Gao accused his cousin Liu Xu of beating his mother; Xu was a junior officer in the Palace Corps, and Zhong Ying, without waiting for imperial approval, had him beaten to death.

sentences.zh: 爲北司所譖，改右散騎常侍，權知吏部尚書銓事。

translations.literal: Slandered by the Northern Bureau, he was changed to Right Regular Attendant and given provisional charge of the Ministry of the Civil Office and its selection affairs.
